goal: Make active workstream reservation authority a versioned main-owned contract and prevent a worker from being blocked merely because its historical branch copy of reservation.json differs from refreshed main.
baseline_impact: none; this extends CAP-0010 governance/control-plane guards and preserves Evidence, PIT/no-lookahead, Reality/Judgment/Outcome, provenance, database-generation and worker single-writer semantics
baseline_invariants: main/integration remains the only reservation authority and shared-state writer
workers cannot mutate reservation/change-contract/capability-admission authority in their implementation diff
worker substantive work still requires refreshed reservation/fence agreement and exact-head CLEAN continuity
no L3/L4 semantic owner or product schema is changed
schema_impact: no JSON schema version change; reservation_revision receives an enforced transition invariant and worker boundary evaluation reads refreshed integration-base reservation authority
affected_invariants: active reservation authority mutation must advance reservation_revision exactly once
worker cursor acknowledgement, not branch-local reservation equality, proves adoption of refreshed main authority
acceptance: PR CI rejects an active reservation authority-field mutation when reservation_revision is unchanged.
PR CI rejects a revision bump with no authority mutation and rejects skipped revision numbers.
Worker boundary checks load the reservation from the supplied integration/base ref and compare only cursor identity, reservation_revision and assignment_epoch acknowledgements against it.
An actual worker-authored change to reservation.json, change-contract.json or capability-admission.json still fails the changed-path gate.
A cursor that has not adopted a newer main reservation revision stops with an explicit authority-update-pending error before substantive work.
Task-stage narrowing that does not change durable workstream acceptance is routed through Change Contract/admission/prompt/cursor rather than mutating reservation.done_when.
The Shipping PR #181 compatibility defect is repaired separately by restoring its original revision-1 done_when, without touching the Shipping worker branch.
Architecture Baseline focused regressions and full CI pass on the exact final PR head.
